checks.name: Base model identities in the three-cell-fragment snapshot
checks.observation: Each fragment record uses a distinct base product model. Panasonic /2, /4 and /4H retail quantities remain search-only aliases, not separate records or connected packs.

checks.name: Same-product variant counting, in memory
checks.observation: Two variants with the same brand/model, additional packaging alias and repeated source IDs produce one independent product, two variant records and one extra variant.

checks.name: Baseline exclusion for the three-cell-fragment subset
checks.observation: None of the 20 fragment brand/model identities overlaps the baseline. The code selects second-batch records using product identity rather than new catalog IDs.

checks.name: Baseline object preservation at initial canonical read
checks.observation: At the initial read, canonical model and source objects equalled the baseline objects and the catalog contained the original 12-model release. The separate merged snapshot below records the later 44-model release.

checks.name: Panasonic duplicate URL scope
checks.observation: The baseline panasonic-nimh-psds-2020 object retains BK-3MCC/BK-4MCC applicability. The separate panasonic-nimh-psds-2020-batch2 object applies to BK-3HCC/BK-4HCC/BK-3LCC/BK-4LCC. Their shared URL accounts for the source-record/unique-URL difference.

actionable_findings.evidence: An in-memory existing product with a trailing brand space is counted as one new product by the reviewed selector, while normalized selection counts zero and coverage_counts groups it with the original product.
actionable_findings.recommended_action: Use the same normalized brand/model key in all three calculations.
actionable_findings.current_data_impact: No observed inflation: all current fragment identities lack surrounding whitespace.
actionable_findings.initial_issue: Second-batch identity keys use casefold() while coverage_counts and semantic identity validation use strip().casefold().
actionable_findings.resolution: product_key now uses strip().casefold() and is shared by coverage_counts, original_products, added_models and verified_rechargeable_lithium_independent_models. In-memory leading/trailing-space variants have the same product key, remain excluded from new-product selection and count as one product with two variant records.

actionable_findings.evidence: The immutable baseline plus the three current fragments contains 49 source records and 48 distinct URL strings.
actionable_findings.recommended_action: Keep the existing record count and add a separately labelled unique URL count; do not merge immutable baseline source objects.
actionable_findings.current_data_impact: Product counts are unaffected. The added metric makes intentional duplicate URL scope explicit.
actionable_findings.initial_issue: The reviewed report includes source-record count but no unique-source-URL count.
actionable_findings.resolution: The report now exposes unique_source_urls separately from sources. Direct read-only counts confirm 61 source records and 60 distinct URL strings in both merged JSON and SQLite, matching the saved report.

counting_review.scope_note: The fragment_snapshot and added_* fields describe only the three cell research fragments. The current_merged_catalog_snapshot separately describes the complete merged catalog and second batch, including pack records.
counting_review.baseline_plus_cell_fragments_scope_note: 49 records and 48 URLs are the baseline plus the three-cell-fragment subset, not the complete merged catalog.

canonical_coverage.counting_note: Independent products use normalized brand plus exact model; aliases, packaging counts and repeated source pages do not increase the count. Capacity-kind counts may overlap.

second_batch_coverage.counting_note: Independent products use normalized brand plus exact model; aliases, packaging counts and repeated source pages do not increase the count. Capacity-kind counts may overlap.

limitations: This remains a two-model independent manufacturer-source sample. Current merged-catalog verification totals are recomputed from declared file statuses; this follow-up does not independently re-establish source facts for the other 42 products.

The initial snapshot and current merged result are recorded separately. The initial 20/14 cell verified counts were inconsistent with the fingerprinted LF105-partial file and are superseded by the directly rechecked 19/13 counts.

Product grouping cannot automatically determine whether different manufacturer MPNs are packaging aliases. The three cell fragments use inspected base identities and search-only retail aliases; merged catalog counts follow normalized brand plus exact model.

The saved full validation report was read and compared, not rerun. This follow-up used read-only JSON/SQLite queries, non-mutating schema validation and in-memory key/count tests. No application integration, deployment, broad application tests or catalog/database write commands were performed.
Public reference specifications do not establish school stock or school procurement coverage.

review_history.explanation: The initial audit paired earlier live count output with subsequently read file fingerprints. Its 20/14 verified totals do not describe the fingerprinted LF105-partial fragment and must not be used as a consistent verified-count snapshot. The original reported values are retained here to make the correction explicit.

Directly re-read all three cell fragments, recomputed their counts using the current coverage_counts/product_key functions, and read the merged canonical catalog, saved validation report and reference SQLite database. The recorded LFP fingerprint remains 6f23622ce5f3cb21716d81174caa79b7c2729d519c729b5c48cb7bab168a1f4a; its LF105 record is partial. Correct verified totals are 19 cell models and 13 rechargeable lithium cell models. This follow-up changes only this audit record.
